use_case: Chrome extension application and toolbar icon
edit_prompt: Edit only the color scheme of the supplied Better Excalidraw icon. Preserve the uppercase cursive B monogram geometry, proportions, placement, double-line construction, two underline strokes, padding, bevel depth, and overall composition. Change the entire background to clean white #FFFFFF. Change the lettering and underline strokes to brand violet #6965DB, with darker violet inline detail and a soft light-violet/gray shadow for separation on white. Keep the exact visible text as one uppercase B only. Produce a crisp, polished, high-contrast 1024x1024 opaque RGB icon.
negative_prompt: Do not change the monogram shape. Do not add symbols, words, borders, mockup frames, transparency, texture, cropping, or watermarks.
validation: PNG is 1024x1024 RGB with no alpha
SVG is a self-contained wrapper embedding the approved PNG
Rendered text is exactly B and remains readable
Decorative curves and underline strokes are not cropped
No border, mockup frame, extra symbol, or transparent background
